uncertainty: The aimdive release gate compares the double 25.0 at 00CE3880 against the absolute value of the signed quantity written at 009C5C9B, the same quantity the pitch command at 009C5CFA is scaled from. That quantity's producer is BSP_Math_InterpolateClamped 00419010 at 009C5C92 with three pushed floats, and its units were not established, so whether the gate is tight or vacuous is open. The aimglide release's four frame slots ([ESP+10h], [ESP+14h], [ESP+18h], [ESP+20h]) were not traced to their producers either; its gates, its constants and its salvo loop are transcribed, the geometry behind them is not. The approach update's tail 009C7C5B-009C7E9E is read for its outputs only. The flyabove, turndown, goaway and attackrun ticks are censused for their command-block writes and their own flag writes, not transcribed.
